hardware.availableForModelReason: Free RAM does not include the runtime, KV cache, unified GPU memory, OS, Forger, browser and build headroom; no available-for-model estimate is derived.
hardware.classification: detection only, not a calibration or performance measurement

timeToFirstTokenMs.reason: Codex JSONL does not expose the first model token. First process output is not TTFT.

generationTokensPerSecond.reason: No token-timed inference trace is available.

peakRuntimeMemoryBytes.reason: Runtime and unified GPU memory are not sampled by this runner.

outOfMemory.reason: Only explicit process/runtime resource errors are identifiable; OS memory pressure is not instrumented.

promptTokens.reason: The model tokenizer and complete rendered tool/context messages are not observed.

cloudCost.reason: Local execution; no cloud billing request is made.

modelLoadMs.reason: Load timing is not separately observed; the model may already be resident.

initialDownloadMs.reason: Downloads are outside benchmark execution and never initiated by this runner.

internalModelRetries.reason: Internal CLI/runtime retries are not exposed as a reliable counter.

observed.toolCallEvidence: Distinct item IDs with explicit command/file/tool types in Codex JSONL; not inferred from token count.

relevantFilesRead.reason: Complete file retrieval is not exposed by the CLI stream.

loadPhase.reason: Cold start, resident model and initial download are not conflated. Load state must be independently instrumented before cold/warm comparison.

privacy.inference: loopback only; enforced by provider preflight
privacy.evaluator: Docker network=none, no host write mounts, no secrets injected
privacy.agentSubprocesses: Codex safe workspace sandbox; no claim of absolute host or OS isolation

networkLimitations: The existing Codex workspace-write tool sandbox has network_access=false; the authenticated gateway rejects inference redirects.
The whole CLI process is not covered by an outer network sandbox, and its total egress is unverified.

limitations: RSS is sampled per-process resident memory and may double-count shared pages; it is not a unified-memory high-water mark.
Free memory is not available-for-model memory. GPU allocations, caches and memory pressure require additional instrumentation.
vm_stat and swap describe system-wide activity, not causal attribution to the model.
Sampling itself has overhead; transient peaks between samples may be missed.
